patch_description: Keep the baseline direct-demand reward, and add a modest positive interaction for selecting links whose endpoints have similar network roles. Two outgoing neighbors with similar demand profiles offer redundant downstream options; likewise, two incoming neighbors with similar profiles offer redundant origins. Penalizing these pairs encourages the two links at each node to provide more diverse routing options, while the direct-demand reward still favors useful links. Cosine normalization makes the interactions comparable across nodes with different total demand. The construction adds at most \(n(n-1)(n-2)\) quadratic terms.
